title: stack-kit driver registry
description: The kit's drivers/registry.json and a project's own registry (drivers.registry), validated together as one composed registry by `validate` (ADR-001 amendment 12). Roles are held to catalogs.roles in code.

roles.description: The roles the driver serves, first = a module's default role (catalogs.roles, or `any`)

runtime.description: Removed in 1.2.0: a command runs by its script's runtime (config/runtimes.json, manifest `runtimes`) or the command's own `runtime`. Read and ignored, with a notice

launch.description: The launch configuration as data, rendered per module by the kit's template grammar over the module's entry and {module}, {path}, {label}, {script}, {envFile} and each declared value (a former launch-kind string is no longer built: declare the data)

label.description: The launch's name, rendered (the module's debug.label wins; else the module id)

values.description: name -> its sources, the first that yields one wins (lib/vscode_gen.py): field (exists), driver, value, glob (single | as dotted under), file + capture

optional.description: Launch keys dropped when they have no value

health.description: How the driver's modules answer a health probe (ADR-001 amendment 26): `expect` `status` -- a 2xx answers, the body is never read (the default, a role's `healthExpect`, stands where this is absent); `pathRequired` -- the roles whose module must declare `container.healthPath`, the role's default path being another runtime's

runsOn.description: The CI runner a module of this driver builds on (default ubuntu-latest)

deployArgs.description: Former home of the release rung's args; read

container.description: How a release of the driver's modules runs (ADR-001 amendment 13): a recipe `template` (driver-relative, rendered per module: {toolchain.version|...}, {artifact}, {port}, {entry}, {healthcheck}; a web server's also {serve}, {webRoot}, {config}); `port`, `artifact`, `entry`, `probe`, `healthPath`, `serve`, and a web server's `serverConfig` (its config template, rendered into the release beside the recipe) and `webRoot`. A `static` image serving a mounted release was retired in 2.4.0 (ADR-001 amendment 18)

dev.description: Remote dev of the driver's modules: `image`, `command`, `build`, `port`, `caches` {name: mount}, `excludes`, `inherited`, `projectReferences`, `reactions` [{globs, do}]

buildTools.description: The build tools a module of this driver may be built by, in order: the first whose `when` file is in the module is its tool; its `wrapper` (committed beside the build file) is used, else `fallback` on the PATH. validate names a module with no build file, and one without its wrapper (the build would depend on whatever this machine has).

outputs.description: What the driver's toolchain writes: gitignore-style patterns relative to the module path (`bin/` a directory of that name at any depth). Never tracked (validate refuses a tracked file one matches), never drafted from, never synced

audit.description: A dependency audit's facts, read by the driver's own audit command (a module's `audit` over it): scanner, image, args, lockfiles, unlocked
